en: A sepia-toned image depicting a row of older buildings with gabled roofs set back from a riverbank. The architecture appears central or eastern European, with simple rectangular windows and minimal decoration. The foreground shows the calm surface of a river reflecting trees and the buildings. There are tall poplar or similar trees lining the riverbank and scattered people or animals on the grassy slope.
